figurative_meaning_en: To accept everything without protest or objection
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অন্যায়ের মুখে টু শব্দও করল না।
পরিবারের সিদ্ধান্ত মেনে টু শব্দ না করে চুপচাপ রইল।
example_sentences_in_english: He didn't utter a word in the face of injustice.
She quietly accepted the family's decision without protest.
note: This idiom emphasizes passive acceptance, common in Bengali cultural contexts of avoiding confrontation.
